label: Взгляд
description: A 10-sentence usage card for взгляд (glance; view).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Взгляд' stays in the nominative as the thing described. 'Добрый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'у неё' shows whose gaze it is. A description of a look.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Взгляд' is the accusative direct object of 'бросил', identical to the nominative for this inanimate masculine noun. 'Быстрый' agrees, giving the idiom for a quick glance.
Strategic focus: Genitive object after negation. 'Взгляда' is the genitive after the negated 'не выдержал'. 'Его' is the unchanging possessive. A natural pattern for not enduring a gaze.

Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'Взгляду' is the dative governed by 'по' to mean judging by her look. 'Её' is the unchanging possessive, and 'всё понятно' is the impersonal predicate. An inference phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'за'. 'Взглядом' is the instrumental required by 'следить за' to mean follow his gaze. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject. A common verb-government model.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В его взгляде' uses the prepositional 'взгляде' after 'в' to locate the emotion in the look. 'Печаль' is the nominative subject of 'была'. A poetic frame.

Strategic focus: Accusative in a set phrase. 'На мой взгляд' uses the accusative 'взгляд' in the fixed idiom meaning in my opinion. 'Мой' agrees, and 'это ошибка' is the nominative judgement. A high-frequency opener.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Взгляды' is the nominative plural meaning views or opinions, the subject of the sentence. 'Наши' agrees in the plural, and 'разные' describes them. Shows the plural sense.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Взгляды' is the accusative plural object of 'обсуждаем', identical to the nominative plural for this inanimate noun. 'Разные' agrees. A discussion phrase.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Взгляды' is the nominative plural subject of 'встретились'. 'Их' is the unchanging possessive, and 'на секунду' gives the brief duration. A narrative moment.
